decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's core industrial door range and costs little to keep as a configurable variant, and the 2018-2019 results showed no sign that its value is failing, so the option stays open.
Demand for insulated glazed industrial doors is backed by energy-efficiency requirements, so this low-cost variant within the established platform keeps its value and should be kept.
The product had its own page in both observed years, which signals a deliberate commitment and good prospects, so there is no evidence justifying abandonment.
